Plan: empty search spinner fix done

In three sentences

Clearing the search box leaves the spinner on forever (B-1). We move the empty-query check in useSearch above the line that turns loading on, and drive the change with the failing test from the bug report. Users get the "Type to search recipes" empty state back the moment they clear the box.

Before / After

Before

Clearing the box hides the results and shows a spinner that never stops. See the repro screenshot.

After

Clearing the box shows the empty state within 300 ms. See the QA screenshot.

Screens that must match: none; no mockups because the empty state already exists.

Scope

src/search/useSearch.ts, src/search/useSearch.test.ts, and the empty-state branch of src/search/SearchPage.tsx.

Constraints

No new dependencies. Keep the 250 ms debounce. Keep the spinner and empty-state designs.

Non-goals

No refactor of the hook, no new empty-state design, and nothing for the sweep's suspected items.

Ask-first actions

Changing src/api/recipes.ts, the debounce, or any page other than search.

Cross-cutting

  • Security: n/a because no input handling or auth changes.
  • Privacy: n/a because no data is stored or sent.
  • Observability: n/a because the page logs nothing today and the fix adds no new failure path.
  • Migration and rollback: n/a because there is no data; rollback is a revert of one commit pair.
  • Performance: addressed in P-1; an empty query now makes no request at all.

How we will know it works

J-1 · Clearing the box shows the empty state covers P-1

Given the search page is showing results for "soup"
When the user clears the search box
Then within 300 ms the spinner is gone and the "Type to search recipes" empty state shows

Continues to show the spinner while a non-empty query is loading, then its results
Continues to show the error banner when the request fails
Continues to keep the ?q= URL parameter in step with the box

Check app: screenshots of the cleared state on desktop light and phone dark, plus one of a loading query, in evidence/qa/

[ASSUMPTION: 300 ms is a fair upper bound for "within a moment"; the debounce alone is 250 ms.]

S-1 · Search unit tests covers P-1

Run pnpm test src/search → expect all tests pass, including "clears loading when the query is emptied".

Packages

P-1 · Spinner clears on an empty query

Outcome: an empty or whitespace query never turns loading on, and shows the empty state.

bug-fix frontend · Depends on: nothing · Rollback: n/a because it touches no data.

Approach

Start from the failing test in the bug report. Move the if (!query.trim()) guard above setLoading(true), and in that branch clear the results and set loading to false. Leave the fetch path as it is.
